Six-Legged Superheavy Ground Drone (Its sheer size takes up a 10x10m/yds [5x5 squares] area centered on itself). A six-legged super-heavy drone filling a 10×10m area. Melee and Martial Arts don't halve its SP; explosive ablation is 1 less. Each leg is a ROF1 melee weapon (6d6). Camera with Anti-Dazzle and LL/IR/UV; 100m radar/sonar and radar detector. At 30 HP or less it launches four Griffins and two unarmed Wyverns that repair it 10 HP a Turn until it's back to 50, then redock. A Phaeton Demon (REZ 40, Interface 8, 4 NET Actions, Combat Number 18) guards its Control Node and runs its drones. Armed with the three weapons below, which only work in a Chimera.

Cost: 250,000eb
MOVE: 3
HP: 200
SP: 18
CN: 18
Counter: DV29 E/S Tech, 10 min to counter
